subject: general
question: ISRO established the third Space Technology Incubation Centre (S-TIC) to encourage start-up and entrepreneurship among the student community and to develop an academic industry ecosystem for space technology in the country at:

options.text: National Institute of Technology, Andhra Pradesh

solution:
The correct answer is__** the National Institute of Technology, Tiruchirappalli**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ISRO established its third Space Technology Incubation Centre (S-TIC) at NIT-Tiruchirappalli in 2019.
 
• This initiative aims to foster innovation and entrepreneurship in the field of space technology by providing a platform for students and researchers to develop and commercialize their ideas.
 
• The third S-TIC was established at the National Institute of Technology, Tiruchirappalli (NIT-T).
 
• The primary goals of S-TICs are:
 
 
• Encouraging Startups: To provide a platform for students, researchers, and entrepreneurs to develop innovative space technology-based products and services.
 
• Industry-Academia Collaboration: To bridge the gap between academia and industry by facilitating partnerships and collaborations.
 
• Skill Development: To train and equip the next generation of space technologists and entrepreneurs.
 
• Regional Development: To promote regional innovation and development in the field of space technology.
 
 
 
• By setting up S-TICs, ISRO aims to create a vibrant ecosystem for space technology innovation in India, leading to the development of new technologies and applications that can benefit society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• NIT Calicut, NIT Andhra Pradesh, and NIT Karnataka are also prestigious institutions with potential for space technology research and development.
 
• However, as of now, they do not have dedicated S-TICs.​
